title: chase brown stands out in 2026 fantasy football
subtitle: the player is drawing attention for his combination of rushing and receiving
excerpt: Chase Brown emerges as a favorite in 2026 fantasy football drafts, with high rushing and receiving scores, according to a FantasyLife analysis.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Chase Brown has been drawing attention on 2026 fantasy football platforms, being named by experts as one of the most promising players for the upcoming year. The FantasyLife analysis highlights that Brown ranks 10th overall on the draft list and has a performance that places him among the best running backs and receivers.

overall draft position

In FantasyLife's evaluation, Brown appears at 10th overall, with a ranking of RB5 compared to an ADP of 14.0 and RB8 on other lists. This position reflects confidence that the player can outperform the average of players at his position.

rushing performance

The player has a 21.5% TPRR rate and 56.3% of rushes inside the 10-yard line on the Cincinnati team. In addition, Brown's 15.6% explosive run rate when under center is the third-highest among qualified RBs.

contribution as a receiver

With a Receiver Score in the 95.7th percentile, Brown ranks third among 47 qualified RBs. This score indicates that he has a significant role as a receiver, which increases his value in drafts.

scoring projections

For 2026, Chase Brown's projected points per game is 14.9, surpassing the average of 14.2 points he had previously recorded. These projections place him as one of the most efficient players in terms of scoring.

impact on the fantasy draft

The data indicates that, despite some limitations in two-minute situations, few running backs have the combination of catches, scoring opportunities, and offensive ceiling that Chase Brown offers. This makes him a priority target in fantasy football drafts.

With information from FantasyLife.
